en_title: Read the summary and review scope
zh_lead: 打开报告后，先核对文件，再查看统计和检测范围。结果总数不代表所有规则都已成功执行。
en_lead: First confirm the file, then read the summary and review scope. The finding count does not mean that every selected check ran successfully.
zh_steps: 核对文件名与报告时间，避免误看旧版本论文。
查看严重、警告、提示和规则未实现警告等数量。徽标的颜色、图标和含义见本章专页。
展开“本次检测范围”查看所选规则，并结合规则筛选列表中的执行状态，判断是否需要补跑或人工复核。
en_steps: Check the filename and report time to avoid reading a report for an older thesis version.
Review the Critical, Warnings, Info and Unverified counts. A dedicated badge guide in this chapter explains the colours and icons.
Expand Review scope to see the selected checks. Also inspect execution statuses in the check filter to decide whether to resume checks or review an item manually.
zh_note: “0 项问题”不等于论文合规证明。未完成、失败、不适用或无法判定的检查，仍需结合说明处理。
en_note: Zero findings is not a certificate of compliance. Read the explanations for checks that failed, were incomplete, were not applicable or could not reach a conclusion.
zh_caption: 核对文件、汇总结果与检测范围
en_caption: File identity, summary and review scope

zh_title: 对照论文阅读检测结果
zh_lead: 报告详情分为左侧 PDF 和右侧结果列表，两边分别滚动。先读清问题说明，再核对论文上下文。
en_lead: Report details contain a PDF pane on the left and findings on the right. Each pane scrolls independently. Read the explanation, then check the surrounding thesis text.
zh_steps: 点击右侧结果，或卡片中的“跳到第…页”，定位相关页面。
有精确位置的结果可能显示高亮；仅有页码的结果不一定出现精确框选。
结合原文判断是否修改，不要仅凭规则名或颜色直接改动论文。
en_steps: Select a finding or its Go to Page link to navigate to the relevant page.
A highlight may appear when a precise location is available. A page-level finding may navigate without an exact highlight.
Use the thesis context to decide whether a change is needed. Do not revise solely on the basis of a rule name or badge colour.
zh_note: 论文印刷页码可能使用罗马数字，与 PDF 实际页序不同。阅读工具输入的是 PDF 页序；卡片可能显示识别出的论文页码。 卡片对勾是本次页面的临时已处理标记，刷新后不保留，也不会修改论文。
en_note: Printed thesis page labels, including Roman numerals, may differ from PDF page order. The reading-tool input uses PDF page order; finding cards may show detected thesis page labels. The card checkmark is a temporary handled marker: it resets on refresh and does not edit the thesis.
zh_caption: PDF 与检测结果联动；论文正文已隐藏
en_caption: Linked PDF and findings panes; thesis text is hidden

zh_lead: 点击 PDF 面板右上角“阅读工具”展开工具栏。工具只改变阅读方式，不会修改论文、结果或执行状态。
en_lead: Select Reading tools at the upper right of the PDF pane. These controls change the view without editing the thesis, findings or check statuses.
zh_steps: 左右箭头：上一页、下一页。页码框：输入有效的 PDF 页序后按 Enter。
斜线眼睛：隐藏高亮；眼睛：显示选中结果的高亮；荧光笔：显示所有可用高亮。
放大镜减号／加号：缩小／放大。链条图标：在新标签页打开完整原始 PDF。
en_steps: Left/right arrows: previous/next page. Page input: enter a valid PDF page number and press Enter.
Crossed-out eye: hide highlights. Eye: show the selected finding's highlights. Highlighter: show all available highlights.
Minus/plus magnifiers: zoom out/in. Link icon: open the complete original PDF in a new tab.
zh_note: 新标签页中的文件是上传的论文原始 PDF，不是检测报告。保存检测结果请用“下载检测报告”。
en_note: The new tab opens the original thesis PDF, not the review report. To save findings, use Download report.
zh_caption: 翻页、页码、高亮、缩放与原始 PDF 工具
en_caption: Pages, highlights, zoom and original-PDF controls

zh_lead: 结果较多时，先按问题类别筛选，再用规则下拉框缩小范围。筛选只改变当前显示，不会删除结果。
en_lead: For a long list, first choose a finding category, then narrow the view with the check dropdown. Filtering changes what is shown; it does not delete findings.
zh_steps: 选择“全部、严重、警告、提示、规则未实现警告”。选择“全部”恢复全部类别。
打开下拉框选择具体规则，或选择“全部检查项”恢复全部规则。
查看右侧数量和状态徽标。三角形加数字通常表示问题数量；旋转圆环、盾牌等另有含义，见下一页。
en_steps: Choose All, Critical, Warnings, Info or Unverified. Select All to restore all categories.
Select a specific check in the dropdown, or choose All checks to restore the full scope.
Read counts and badges beside each check. A warning triangle with a number usually counts findings; spinners, shields and other icons have different meanings, explained next.
zh_note: 实时报告筛选后仍可能保留正在执行的规则。当前筛选下没有结果，不代表整份报告没有其他类别的问题。
en_note: Running checks may remain visible in the live-report filter. An empty filtered list does not mean the report has no findings in other categories.
zh_caption: 类别筛选、规则筛选及数量／状态徽标
en_caption: Category/check filters, with count and status badges

zh_lead: 如认为某条结果准确或存在误判，可在结果卡片内反馈。此处评价的是这一条检测结果。
en_lead: If a finding is accurate or seems incorrect, give feedback within its card. This feedback concerns that individual finding.
zh_steps: 在“这个问题的判断是否准确？”处选择点赞或点踩。
按需选择原因并补充说明，尽量写清误判位置及理由。
点击“提交反馈”；已提交的评价可通过“取消评价”撤回。
en_steps: Choose thumbs up or thumbs down under Is this finding accurate?
Select a reason and add comments if useful. Explain the location and reason for the problem.
Select Submit feedback. Use Withdraw feedback to remove a submitted rating.
zh_note: 反馈不会自动删除问题或修改论文。此入口与建议评价、右上角“使用反馈”不同。
en_note: Feedback does not automatically remove a finding or edit the thesis. It is separate from suggestion feedback and the Feedback control in the page header.
zh_caption: 结果评价、原因与提交入口
en_caption: Finding rating, optional reason and submission

zh_title: 阅读修复建议并修改源文件
en_title: Review suggestions and edit your source
zh_lead: 部分结果支持生成修复建议。建议帮助理解如何调整，不能替代你对论文原文和学校要求的判断。
en_lead: Some findings support generated suggestions. These explain possible changes, but do not replace your judgement about the thesis or university requirements.
zh_steps: 在支持该功能的卡片中点击“获取修复建议”，等待返回后完整阅读。
核对建议与原文，在本地 Word 或 LaTeX 源文件中修改。系统不会自动改写上传的 PDF。
可对建议点赞或点踩。修改后导出新 PDF，从“论文上传”重新提交。
en_steps: Select Get a suggestion on a supported card, wait for the response, and read it in full.
Check it against the thesis, then edit your local Word or LaTeX source. The system does not rewrite the uploaded PDF.
You can rate the suggestion. Export a revised PDF and submit it through Upload thesis.
zh_note: 建议无法生成时，可稍后重试或人工复核。不要用“增量补跑”检测修改后的新论文文件。
en_note: If a suggestion cannot be generated, retry later or review manually. Resume checks does not analyse a newly revised thesis file.
zh_caption: 修复建议与评价；论文摘录已隐藏
en_caption: Suggestions and feedback; thesis excerpts omitted

zh_lead: 核对报告顶部文件名，点击“下载检测报告”，再选择格式。导出的是检测结果，不是论文原始 PDF。
en_lead: Check the filename in the report header, select Download report, then choose a format. This exports the review findings, not the original thesis PDF.
zh_steps: PDF 适合阅读和打印；Word 便于继续整理；Markdown、文本用于保存文字。
图片用于保存报告页面；JSON 提供结构化数据。按需要选择六种格式之一。
导出语言取决于开始下载时的界面语言。导出英文报告前，先等待英文说明准备完整。
en_steps: Choose PDF for reading/printing, Word for further editing, or Markdown or Text for a text copy.
Choose Images to save report pages as images, or JSON for structured data. Select the format you need.
Exports use the interface language at the start of download. Wait for English explanations to be ready before exporting an English report.
zh_note: 中途切换语言不会将一次导出混成双语。引文、文件名保留原语言。取消导出不会取消论文检测。
en_note: Switching language mid-export does not mix languages in that download. Quotations and filenames retain their original language. Cancelling an export does not cancel the review.
zh_caption: 下载入口与六种导出格式
en_caption: Download control and six export formats

zh_lead: 左侧选择“历史报告”，查看本人已保存的报告。先按文件名定位，再核对创建时间，区分论文版本。
en_lead: Select Report history in the sidebar to view your saved reports. Search by filename, then check the creation time to distinguish thesis versions.
zh_steps: 输入文件名关键词搜索。长文件名被省略时，可悬停查看完整名称。
“查看详情”打开报告；“增量补跑”复用旧 PDF 继续检查；“删除”进入确认窗口。
使用底部每页条数和页码浏览记录，不要仅凭列表第一行判断论文版本。
en_steps: Search using part of the filename. Hover over a shortened filename to see the full name.
View report opens a report. Resume checks reuses its saved PDF. Delete report opens a confirmation dialog.
Use the page-size selector and page controls to browse records. Check filenames and times rather than relying on row order alone.
zh_note: 报告与提交账号关联。邮件链接要求登录时，也需使用提交该论文的账号。
en_note: Reports are linked to the submitting account. When an email link asks you to sign in, use that account.
zh_caption: 搜索、查看、补跑、删除与分页

en_title: Resume checks on a saved report
zh_lead: 旧报告有未完成、失败或新增规则时，可使用“增量补跑”。它读取报告保存的旧 PDF，不是电脑上后来修改的文件。
en_lead: Use Resume checks for new, failed or inconclusive checks. It uses the PDF stored with the report, not a file you have since revised on your computer.
zh_steps: 在历史报告或报告顶部点击“增量补跑”，确认弹窗中的文件。
查看哪些规则复用已完成结果、哪些将执行。
确认后运行。系统创建新报告并保留原报告；成功报告同样计入每日额度。
en_steps: Select Resume checks in the history list or report header and confirm the saved file.
Review which completed results will be reused and which checks will run.
Confirm and run. A new report is created and the original is retained. A successful report uses the daily allowance.
zh_note: 论文已修改时，请上传新的 PDF 重新检测。旧 PDF 的补跑结果不能验证修改后的新论文。
en_note: If the thesis has changed, upload the revised PDF for a new review. Resuming checks on an old PDF does not validate the revised thesis.
zh_caption: 保存的 PDF、复用结果与待执行规则
en_caption: Saved PDF, reused results and checks to run

zh_lead: 在历史报告中点击“删除”后，先阅读确认窗口。删除无法撤销，需保留的报告请先下载。
en_lead: After selecting Delete report, read the confirmation dialog carefully. Deletion cannot be undone; download any report you need to keep first.
zh_steps: 核对窗口中的文件名，确保不是仍需保留的版本。
不确定时选“取消”；确认不再需要后，再选“删除”。
删除的是系统中的报告及保存的 PDF，不影响电脑原文件，也不退还检测额度。
en_steps: Check the filename and make sure you do not need that version.
Choose Cancel if unsure. Select Delete only when you no longer need the report.
The report and stored PDF are removed from the system. Your local file is unaffected, and used allowance is not restored.
zh_note: 批量删除具有同样的不可撤销性，方法见下一页。
en_note: Batch deletion is also irreversible. The next page explains selecting multiple records.
zh_caption: 删除前核对文件；不确定时取消
en_caption: Check the file before deleting; cancel if unsure

zh_lead: 在历史报告右上角点击“管理记录”。进入管理模式后，先勾选，再核对数量。
en_lead: Select Manage records at the upper right of Report history. Select records, then check the selection count before taking action.
zh_steps: 勾选需要管理的报告。使用表头复选框时，注意实际选中的记录。
核对已选数量和文件名。
需要删除时点击“删除所选”并完成确认；点击“完成”退出管理模式。
en_steps: Select the reports to manage. If you use the header checkbox, check which records are actually selected.
Review the selected count and filenames.
Select Delete selected and confirm if you want to remove them. Select Done to leave management mode.
zh_note: 不要在未核对文件和数量时直接批量删除。先导出需要保留的报告。
en_note: Do not batch-delete before checking the files and count. Export reports you need to keep first.
zh_caption: 勾选、已选数量与批量删除
en_caption: Selection, selected count and batch deletion
